subject.title: [Bug]: custom Xiaomi MiMo models generate invalid max_completion_tokens when maxTokens is not specified

question: Which linked PR should be the canonical fix for the omitted custom-model `maxTokens` regression?
rationale: The issue is valid and several open PRs target the same root cause, but only a maintainer should choose the accepted fallback semantics and landing branch.

options.title: Use the proof-sufficient resolver PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98430 as the canonical fix if maintainers accept provider-default behavior when no maxTokens metadata exists.

options.title: Require different fallback semantics
options.body: Ask the linked PRs to fail early or derive a validated cap if maintainers do not want omitted maxTokens to rely on upstream provider defaults.

options.title: Choose another linked candidate
options.body: Use another open candidate only if it proves the same source path and handles the custom configured-row case at least as narrowly.

recommendation.title: Use the proof-sufficient resolver PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98430 as the canonical fix if maintainers accept provider-default behavior when no maxTokens metadata exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest recent history in the configured/static fallback resolver that introduces the reported value.
